svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 457 x 297 mm from 3 mm ceramic fibre sheet with a sharp knife

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a steel rule; trim so it lies flat on the tray floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 12 mm holes at the standoff positions (the same places as the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tray's stud holes): 124 mm each side front to back, at 210 left,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 left and 120 right of centre. Cut with a 12 mm hole punch or knife.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wear a dust mask (FFP2 or N95), gloves and long sleeves; cut outdoors

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: or with dust extraction; wet-wipe the bench afterwards.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies loose on the floor round the standoffs, 2 mm clear of each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no tears; the floor is covered except at the six holes.
